name: LY215840
summary: LY-215,840 is an ergoline and lysergamide derivative drug developed by Eli Lilly, which acts as a potent and selective antagonist at the serotonin 5-HT2 and 5-HT7 receptors. It has anti-hypertensive and muscle relaxant effects in animal studies.

uses.text: LY-215,840 is an ergoline and lysergamide derivative drug developed by Eli Lilly, which acts as a potent and selective antagonist at the serotonin 5-HT2 and 5-HT7 receptors.

fact.en: As an ergoline, it shares the four-ring core of LSD and the ergot alkaloids, yet it blocks 5-HT2 receptors rather than activating them.
fact.zh: 作為麥角靈類，它與 LSD 和麥角生物鹼共用同一個四環核心，卻是阻斷而不是活化 5-HT2 受體。
fact.zhHans: 作为麦角灵类，它与 LSD 和麦角生物碱共用同一个四环内核，却是阻断而不是活化 5-HT2 受体。
